_note: Hand-written predictions of what Nemotron should return for Miodrag's three demo instructions. NOT model output. Used as test fixtures (mocked responses) and in DEMO_PLAN.md. rim_counts=false for the first is the prediction from the intent-contract run, where a literal 'in the bowl' gave rim_counts=false 18/18; the project rule counts the rim.

put the fruit away.policy_instruction: Pick up the banana and place it in the bowl
put the fruit away.reason: The banana is the only fruit and the bowl the only container, so 'away' most plausibly means into the bowl, which is the tested task.
ambiguities: 'away' does not name a destination; the bowl is assumed because it is the only container

put the banana beside the bowl, on its l.policy_instruction: Put the banana on the table to the left of the bowl
put the banana beside the bowl, on its l.reason: Placing the banana next to the bowl has never been tried with this policy; it is safe to attempt but likely to fail.
ambiguities: 'its left' needs a viewpoint: the robot's left is assumed

pick up the bowl and put it on the banan.policy_instruction: Pick up the bowl and put it on the banana
pick up the bowl and put it on the banan.reason: The policy has only been tested moving the banana; lifting the bowl onto the banana is untested and could knock objects off the table.
